priya_cs: Heads-up — VertexWorks (trial) spiked ~4x usage in last 48h; estimated daily token burn $3.2k vs baseline $800. Proposing temporary soft cap (200k tokens/day) + proactive comms + optional enablement. Need quick alignment.

liam_csm: Ack. Timeline?

priya_cs: Prefer rollout within 48h. Draft comms below. @jordan_se can you confirm if errors/latency tied to model selection vs client retries? @nina_ops can you handle applying soft cap and monitoring?

jordan_se: Checked traces — model latency flat. Error rate up due to client-side exponential retries after 429s; server responded 429s when concurrency spiked. Recommend: include Retry-After guidance + suggest backoff in SDK.

nina_ops: I can apply soft cap via quota API and enable a grace window. Can schedule at 2026-04-05 15:00 PT. Will add alert for sustained throttles.

priya_cs: Draft email + in-app banner (please review):

```Subject: Temporary API quota applied to your account — action recommended
Hi Team,

We noticed a rapid increase in API usage from your account that may lead to unexpected costs. To protect you, we've temporarily set a soft daily quota of 200,000 tokens. This is reversible and intended to buy time while we review patterns.

What you can do:
- Review usage dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/accounts/vertexworks/usage
- Reduce bursty retries and implement exponential backoff (see snippet below)
- Book a free 30-min enablement call: https://cal.com/redwood/enablement

If you need an exception or higher cap, reply to this thread and we'll prioritize.

Thanks,
Priya, Customer Success
```

priya_cs: Snippet for SDK backoff (for the email):

```js
async function callWithBackoff(fn) {
  let retries = 0
  while (retries < 5) {
    try { return await fn() } catch (e) {
      if (e.status !== 429) throw e
      await sleep( Math.pow(2, retries) * 250 )
      retries++
    }
  }
  throw new Error('exhausted retries')
}
```

liam_csm: Looks good. Add line about cost estimate and point of contact.

nina_ops: Soft cap scheduled. Quota-bot will post when active.

quota-bot: System: Soft quota of 200000 tokens/day applied to account VertexWorks at 2026-04-05T15:00:00-07:00. Monitor ID: q-1840123456-01.

priya_cs: Thanks everyone. I'll send the email after ops confirms deployment and add an enablement slot to the calendar. :thumbsup:
